name: Supplier watchlist – insolvency and register notices

parameters.content:
## Daily supplier watchlist

### How it works
Watches your suppliers daily. **Imprint & VAT Check** reads each supplier's legal notice once: legal name, register court, type and number, EU VAT ID checked against VIES. The workflow remembers the register entry, so later runs read a legal notice only for new domains and for entries older than `refreshLegalNoticeDays`. German suppliers go to the **Insolvency & Handelsregister Monitor** under your `watchlistId` with court, register type and number – or by name and town where the legal notice lacks them (`matchedBy: name`). Its first run returns every company once; later runs return a row only where something changed: a new insolvency notice, an announced deletion, a VAT ID that VIES no longer reports as valid. **Changes to report** lists these rows and every domain not checked, with the reason.

Limits: German companies only; sole traders are left out (status `excluded`). n8n saves the remembered entries only in runs of the active workflow – a manual test run reads them but adds none.

Cost, charged on your Apify account: the legal notice step per website it reads, the monitor per company (less when unchanged on the watchlist), plus a small start fee. Current prices: each actor's Apify Store page.

### Setup
1. Install the Apify community node `@apify/n8n-nodes-apify` (tested with 0.8.1; https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation-and-management/), add an Apify credential and select it in the four Apify nodes.
2. Replace the example domains in **Settings** and choose a `watchlistId`.
3. Click **Test run**, then activate the workflow for the daily schedule.
4. Connect a notification (e-mail, Slack) after **Changes to report**.

### Customization
`alertOn`: `insolvency,register` reports only court and register notices; add `hiring` to hear when open positions drop. `refreshLegalNoticeDays` 0 reads every legal notice on every run.

Independent provider, not affiliated with Apify or the data sources named.

## Suppliers and watchlist
One domain per supplier. Keep `watchlistId` the same on every run: it makes later runs return only changes. Do not run one watchlist in two executions at the same time.

### Replace the example domains
A new domain costs one legal notice check; every supplier costs one monitor check per run. Check the list before you activate the schedule.

## Legal notice, only when needed
Runs for domains that are new or whose entry is older than `refreshLegalNoticeDays`. Charged per website plus a start fee. Sites read through Apify's Web Fetch are billed by Apify on your account.

## Register entry or name
Court, type and number identify a company exactly. Without them a German supplier is passed on by name and town (`matchedBy: name`); others go to the report as not checked. A site without an answer keeps its entry.

## Daily check
A company row (first check or change) costs more than an unchanged company on the watchlist; each run adds a small start fee. On a new watchlist every supplier is a first check: set `maxCostPerRunUsd` high enough for that.

## Changes to report
`rowType` is `change` or `not_checked`. Nothing changed: no item, so a notification stays quiet.
